classification.difficultyReason: The source Development question requires distinguishing four quadrilateral types from equality and parallel markings in varied orientations.

content.prompt: Identify the special quadrilateral as a parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, or kite.

spec.description: Right-leaning parallelogram with horizontal top and bottom edges; distinct matching tick and parallel-arrow sets on the two opposite-side pairs.
spec.mathematics: Both pairs of opposite sides are parallel and equal.
spec.answerVisibility: The figure and its markings are permanent givens. The supplied classification belongs only in the answer.

answer.worked: Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides are marked parallel.

spec.description: Trapezium with a shorter horizontal top, longer horizontal bottom, matching parallel arrows and one equality tick on each sloping side.
spec.mathematics: One pair of opposite sides is parallel; the nonparallel sides are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the side markings are shown in the question; the supplied classification is answer content.

answer.worked: Trapezium: it has one pair of parallel sides. The equal sloping sides do not make a second parallel pair.
